tools.name: NetBox
tools.role: Source of truth for sites, devices, circuits, prefixes, IPs, VLANs, VRFs and ASNs.
tools.boundary: Read adapter and native inventory-profile/ORM seed definitions exist. Actual NetBox startup/seeding and general allocation write automation are not live-validated.

tools.name: FRRouting
tools.role: Run actual BGP, OSPF and BFD control planes on virtual Linux routers.
tools.boundary: Native five-router configurations and isolated Compose topology are defined. Docker execution and BGP/traffic validation are pending.

tools.name: Open vSwitch
tools.role: Virtual switching, VLAN separation and OpenFlow-controlled forwarding.
tools.boundary: An alternative forwarding extension; not required for every FRR lab.

tools.name: Linux tc / netem
tools.role: Traffic shaping, queue policies and reproducible delay/loss on lab interfaces.
tools.boundary: Allowlisted owned netem delay/loss changes are defined for dedicated virtual routers. No container or actual qdisc has been executed on this laptop.

tools.name: OpenDaylight
tools.role: Explore controller-driven SDN and model-based device integration.
tools.boundary: Optional SDN track; protocol/module support must match the selected release and devices.

tools.name: ISC Kea
tools.role: DHCPv4/v6 leases, reservations and IPv6 prefix delegation for virtual clients.
tools.boundary: Consumes address policy; does not decide the whole site's routing design.

tools.name: PowerDNS
tools.role: Authoritative DNS records for sites and customer service endpoints.
tools.boundary: Authoritative and recursive DNS are separate services; choose the required role.

tools.name: FreeRADIUS
tools.role: Authentication, authorization and accounting for network access experiments.
tools.boundary: Access policy is separate from IPAM and radio scheduling.

tools.name: Ansible
tools.role: Execute repeatable device/Linux configuration and verification playbooks.
tools.boundary: Native approved lab tasks and controller review/verification code exist. Live Ansible execution is pending; general vendor provisioning remains external.

tools.name: AWX
tools.role: Run Ansible jobs with inventory, credentials, workflow approvals and job history.
tools.boundary: Strata currently sends generic review webhooks; an AWX receiver/launcher is still needed.

tools.name: Nornir
tools.role: Python inventory and concurrent task dispatch for network automation.
tools.boundary: Alternative automation implementation; not another approval engine.

tools.name: NAPALM
tools.role: Unified getters and configuration operations for supported network OS drivers.
tools.boundary: Candidate/diff/commit/rollback capabilities differ by vendor driver; FRR support must be checked.

tools.name: Netmiko
tools.role: Interact with supported network-device CLIs over SSH.
tools.boundary: CLI transport alone does not provide transaction safety or rollback.

tools.name: Batfish
tools.role: Analyze supported configuration snapshots for reachability and policy before changes.
tools.boundary: Offline model analysis complements live probes; verify support for the selected configuration syntax.

tools.name: Oxidized
tools.role: Capture device configuration versions and detect configuration drift.
tools.boundary: Backups help build a rollback plan; they do not prove rollback execution succeeded.

tools.name: Zabbix
tools.role: Poll device/service metrics and evaluate monitoring triggers.
tools.boundary: External installation required; Strata reads configured item keys and source timestamps.

tools.name: LibreNMS
tools.role: Network discovery, interface/sensor polling and network monitoring.
tools.boundary: Alternative or complementary NMS; avoid double counting shared interface measurements.

tools.name: Prometheus
tools.role: Scrape platform/exporter time series and evaluate alert rules.
tools.boundary: Compose configuration exists; live scrapes require running services.

tools.name: Grafana
tools.role: Visualize worker, connector, Kafka and operational metrics.
tools.boundary: Dashboard provisioning exists; displayed values depend on actual measurements.

tools.name: Alertmanager
tools.role: Group and route Prometheus firing/resolved notifications to incident handling.
tools.boundary: Existing receiver records platform incidents; notification does not itself change a router.

tools.name: Grafana Loki
tools.role: Centralize service logs for incident investigation.
tools.boundary: Log shipping and data-source provisioning are not configured yet.

tools.name: OpenTelemetry
tools.role: Instrument application traces, metrics and logs across services.
tools.boundary: Application telemetry complements device SNMP and routing measurements.

tools.name: chrony
tools.role: Keep Linux lab hosts synchronized so evidence and change timelines can be compared.
tools.boundary: Clock synchronization and timestamp validation must both be checked.

tools.name: Apache Kafka
tools.role: Durable event streams for telemetry, detections and dead-letter records.
tools.boundary: Current lab uses one broker and replication factor 1.

tools.name: Kafka Connect
tools.role: Run connector-based imports/exports around Kafka.
tools.boundary: Choose connectors for actual sources; current Python adapters do not require Connect.

tools.name: Schema Registry
tools.role: Manage event schema versions and compatibility policies.
tools.boundary: Current JSON/Pydantic contracts work without a registry; serializer migration is separate work.

tools.name: MinIO
tools.role: S3-compatible object storage for raw/processed Parquet and model artifacts.
tools.boundary: Pinned community source build replaces an unavailable binary image tag. Upstream community repository is archived; image compilation and live storage remain unverified.

tools.name: Apache Airflow
tools.role: Schedule data-processing DAGs with task dependency tracking.
tools.boundary: Optional orchestration profile; it is not the routing controller or radio scheduler.

tools.name: MLflow
tools.role: Track training runs, evaluation metadata and model artifacts.
tools.boundary: Model evaluations require a representative dataset; storage is not proof of detection quality.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.role: Relational state for applications such as Airflow and future NetBox/AWX services.
tools.boundary: Current PostgreSQL service belongs to Airflow; Strata incident/outbox state still uses SQLite.

tools.name: Containerlab
tools.role: Define repeatable virtual-router nodes and point-to-point links.
tools.boundary: Recommended transport-lab engine; a topology has not been deployed yet.

tools.name: GNS3
tools.role: Build virtual network topologies and connect appliances/probes.
tools.boundary: Existing adapter reads nodes/links; it does not deploy licensed vendor images.

tools.name: EVE-NG
tools.role: Alternative virtual network lab with multi-appliance topologies.
tools.boundary: External installation and version compatibility checks are required.

tools.name: iperf3
tools.role: Generate real lab traffic and measure end-to-end throughput.
tools.boundary: Needs active endpoints; a link label is not a throughput measurement.

tools.name: Wireshark / tshark
tools.role: Inspect packet captures to explain protocol and connectivity failures.
tools.boundary: Capture only the lab interfaces and retain evidence with scenario IDs.

tools.name: Open5GS
tools.role: Run an open-source EPC/5G core with subscriber, session and user-plane functions.
tools.boundary: Pinned source-build and native YAML override/session profile definitions exist. Image compilation, slice compatibility and actual PDU traffic validation are pending; no physical RF is modeled.

tools.name: UERANSIM
tools.role: Simulate UE/gNB protocol behavior against a 5G core for registration and PDU-session tests.
tools.interface: NGAP / NAS / GTP-U / simulated radio link
tools.boundary: Native gNB/UE configurations and source-build profile use public lab fixtures. Real registration/PDU sessions have not run on this laptop.

tools.name: srsRAN Project
tools.role: Explore actual software RAN CU/DU functions in a dedicated RAN lab.
tools.boundary: Radio/PHY testing depends on the selected supported test setup; not bundled into Strata.

tools.name: OpenAirInterface
tools.role: Alternative software RAN/core research and integration track.
tools.boundary: Choose a documented compatible deployment; not a second mandatory RAN stack.

tools.name: Keycloak
tools.role: Operator identity, OIDC login and role-based application access.
tools.boundary: Current shared Hub token is not a Keycloak or RBAC integration.

tools.name: OpenBao
tools.role: Manage service/device secrets and access policies.
tools.boundary: A secret store still needs workload authentication and application integration.

tools.name: n8n
tools.role: Connect incident intake, operator review and operational notifications.
tools.boundary: A compatible idempotent receiver must be built; self-hosting terms are separate from software functionality.

tools.name: Zammad
tools.role: Track incident ownership and change/ticket history.
tools.boundary: Ticket synchronization is planned; opening a ticket does not execute a network change.

tools.name: Docker Compose
tools.role: Run the current persistent backend services and isolated container networks.
tools.boundary: A running Docker Engine is required; no live engine is available in this workspace.

tools.name: Kubernetes
tools.role: Study declarative service orchestration and deployment lifecycle at a later stage.
tools.boundary: Legacy examples are separate from the root Compose runtime; running Kubernetes does not imply HA.

tools.name: Terraform
tools.role: Define infrastructure resources reproducibly when a cloud lab is available.
tools.boundary: Legacy examples are not a verified free-tier deployment; provider resources may incur costs.

tools.name: GitHub Actions
tools.role: Validate configuration candidates and produce repeatable build/evidence artifacts.
tools.boundary: No automated router deployment pipeline is configured; Git push alone does not start the backend.

tools.name: Strata
tools.role: Unify inventory context, incidents, service evidence and operator decision review.
tools.boundary: Current workflows request review; device configuration execution and rollback are external/planned.

tools.name: Groq
tools.role: On-demand structured interpretation of saved incident evidence.
tools.boundary: Optional provider credentials and usage allowance are required; AI does not own IP/routing allocation.

tools.name: OpenAI Decisions
tools.role: Select typed next-step recommendations for operator policy review.
tools.boundary: Recommendations cannot directly execute arbitrary device commands.

allocations.name: IP / VLAN / VRF / ASN plan
allocations.explanation: NetBox records intended allocations. Automation must validate uniqueness and reserve resources before rendering a device configuration.

allocations.name: BGP / OSPF paths and failover
allocations.explanation: Routing daemons calculate paths from protocol state and policy. Ansible applies the intended router settings; NetBox remains the design record.

allocations.name: Bandwidth, queues and loss experiments
allocations.explanation: Linux tc enforces lab egress queue/rate policy. netem reproduces delay and loss. These controls do not allocate physical radio spectrum.

allocations.name: Dynamic client IP leases
allocations.explanation: Kea assigns leases from configured address pools and reservations. IPAM and DHCP must use a shared, validated plan.

allocations.name: UE sessions and user-plane selection
allocations.explanation: Core functions manage subscriber/session context; SMF configures session forwarding through UPF. A PDU session is separate from radio resource allocation.

allocations.name: Radio resources / PRBs / scheduling
allocations.explanation: The RAN scheduler owns radio-resource behavior in a compatible RAN setup. UERANSIM is used here for protocol simulation; RF measurements remain outside its evidence scope.

scenarios.name: Bring a new site online
scenarios.outcome: A reserved allocation matches the rendered configuration, BGP sessions establish, and an end-to-end probe passes.

steps.name: Reserve the intended site resources
steps.evidence: Site ID, unique prefixes/VLANs/ASN and reservation record.

steps.name: Render a bounded configuration candidate
steps.evidence: Candidate diff and allowlisted target inventory.

steps.name: Validate reachability before the change
steps.evidence: Supported snapshot analysis and baseline live probe results.

steps.name: Approve and launch the configuration job
steps.evidence: Job ID, approver and idempotency key.

steps.name: Establish routing and client services
steps.evidence: BGP neighbor state, selected routes and DHCP lease.

steps.name: Verify service traffic and record evidence
steps.evidence: Timestamped probe output, telemetry offsets and stored artifact.

scenarios.name: Recover from an impaired backhaul
scenarios.outcome: Measured service performance returns after a reviewed path change; otherwise the lab restores its baseline.

steps.name: Apply the approved lab impairment
steps.evidence: Selected data interface and before/after qdisc output.

steps.name: Detect measured loss and latency
steps.evidence: Fresh source measurements and firing alert timestamps.

steps.name: Persist the incident and its context
steps.evidence: Incident version, source event IDs and topology context.

steps.name: Review the proposed next step
steps.evidence: Optional AI audit or deterministic runbook review; maintenance and evidence checks.

steps.name: Execute a bounded lab runbook
steps.evidence: Config diff, saved baseline, job result and selected backup route.

steps.name: Verify recovery or roll back
steps.evidence: Post-change traffic measurements; restored baseline when verification fails.

scenarios.name: Explain and recover configuration drift
scenarios.outcome: The changed configuration is traced to a job/actor and the intended reachability is restored or the change is rejected.

steps.name: Compare captured and intended state
steps.evidence: Configuration revision, diff and intended site policy.

steps.name: Reproduce the policy violation
steps.evidence: Snapshot query and a failed lab endpoint probe.

steps.name: Open a reviewed change record
steps.evidence: Incident/change correlation and named reviewer.

steps.name: Apply the supported restoration runbook
steps.evidence: Baseline artifact, target scope and execution result.

steps.name: Confirm the restored network state
steps.evidence: Routes, fresh measurements and new configuration revision.

scenarios.name: Investigate a failed 5G PDU session
scenarios.outcome: UE registration/session behavior and user-plane reachability are explained with protocol evidence, without claiming RF coverage validation.

steps.name: Define the virtual subscriber and core profile
steps.evidence: Lab-only subscriber, PLMN, DNN and address-pool plan.

steps.name: Attempt registration and session establishment
steps.evidence: UE/gNB logs and registration/PDU-session result.

steps.name: Inspect core metrics and packet evidence
steps.evidence: NGAP/NAS/GTP-U capture context and timestamped core observations.

steps.name: Correlate the failure with the intended profile
steps.evidence: Future mobile adapter event contract and saved protocol artifacts.

steps.name: Apply and verify a reviewed lab correction
steps.evidence: Supported core-config diff, restarted test session and user-plane traffic probe.
